identity.name: Hiring Path
identity.definition: A classification that determines which job seekers are eligible to apply for a federal position.

structure.evidence: code, name, description, eligibilityCriteria, iconUrl, activeListingCount — sufficient for a full detail page.

instances.evidence: Open to the public; Federal employees (competitive service); Veterans; Military spouses; Students and recent graduates; National Guard members.

purpose.evidence: Job seekers filter listings by the hiring paths they qualify for to avoid applying for positions they are ineligible for.

sipValidation.verdict: Valid object. Named instances, consistent structure, and a filtering purpose that extends across all Job Listings.

synonyms.notes: Broad term. Hiring path is the specific USAJobs implementation of eligibility categories.
The legal authority under which a hiring path operates. More granular than hiring path.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: URL-safe identifier for the hiring path.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the hiring path.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Plain-language explanation of who qualifies for this hiring path.
attributes.example: Veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces or an eligible family member

attributes.name: eligibilityCriteria
attributes.description: Detailed criteria for determining eligibility. Manually curated.

attributes.name: iconUrl
attributes.description: Icon used in the UI to represent this hiring path.

attributes.name: activeListingCount
attributes.description: Count of currently open Job Listings on this hiring path. Computed at query time.

actions.name: Browse listings by hiring path
actions.description: Navigates to a filtered list of open Job Listings on this hiring path.

actions.name: Share hiring path page
actions.description: Copies or shares a direct URL to the hiring path page.

actions.name: Learn about eligibility
actions.description: Links to detailed eligibility criteria for this hiring path.

relationships.mechanics: Automatic. Job Listings carry one or more hiring path codes that map to this Hiring Path object. No manual curation required.
relationships.cardinality: many-to-many (one Hiring Path applies to many Job Listings; one Job Listing carries multiple Hiring Paths)
relationships.sorts: Default: openDate descending. Options: closeDate ascending, grade descending, salary descending.
relationships.filters: Agency, series, location, grade, appointment type, work schedule.
relationships.dependencies: Optional for Hiring Path. A Hiring Path can exist with zero active listings. Removing a listing does not affect the Hiring Path object.

views.context: A job seeker scanning available hiring paths.
views.userIntent: Identify which hiring path applies to them and find listings they are eligible for.

views.context: A job seeker who has navigated to a hiring path page.
views.userIntent: Confirm their eligibility and browse open listings on this path.

stories.title: Veteran finds positions they are eligible for
stories.benefit: avoids applying to listings they cannot be considered for
stories.whenClause: When a job seeker knows they qualify under a veterans hiring path
stories.thenClause: They see only listings open to veterans across all agencies and series

businessRules.title: Hiring paths are OPM-defined
businessRules.description: The redesign does not create or modify hiring path definitions.

businessRules.title: A listing may have multiple hiring paths
businessRules.description: A job seeker who qualifies under any one of a listing's hiring paths is eligible to apply.

businessRules.title: eligibilityCriteria may be absent
businessRules.description: Manually curated. The detail page must degrade gracefully when absent.

businessRules.title: activeListingCount is live
businessRules.description: Computed from the API at query time, not stored.

states.name: Active
states.description: Hiring path is in current use by OPM and agencies.
states.triggers: Defined by OPM and present in API data.

states.name: Deprecated
states.description: Hiring path has been retired or consolidated by OPM.
states.triggers: OPM removes or replaces the hiring path.
